newsitem.title: CANADA: NBS Technologies Q1 1997 seen below 1996.
newsitem.headline: NBS Technologies Q1 1997 seen below 1996.

text.p: NBS Technologies Inc President and Chief Executive Officer Ken Kivenko said on Tuesday that he expected lower first quarter income in 1997 than the company had reported in the first quarter of 1996.

"While the outlook for 1997 is favourable, income for the first quarter of 1997 is not expected to equal income for the same quarter 1996 due to larger investments in research and development, sales and marketing," he said in a statement.

He said he expects operating results in 1997 to fluctuate based on factors such as shifts in cutomer buying patterns, the timing of product introductions and the schedule of sales and marketing programs.
